Factors That Will Change Your Price:

Vehicle Size: Sedans and coupes are on the lower end of the pricing spectrum, while mid-size SUVs, trucks, and large passenger vans usually cost $30 to $60 extra due to the added surface area.

Add-Ons: Specialized services like excessive pet hair removal, heavy mold remediation, engine bay detailing, headlight restoration, or ozone odor treatments will generally add $50 to $150+ to the base price.
